en: Wash and chop the tomatoes. Beat the eggs in a separate bowl.
Heat oil in a pan. Cook the eggs until set, then transfer to a plate.
Cook the tomatoes until softened. Return the eggs and stir together; season to taste.
Serve with freshly cooked rice. Cook eggs thoroughly and follow local food-safety guidance.
zh-Hant: 洗淨番茄並切塊，另用碗打勻雞蛋。
鍋中加油，將蛋炒至凝固後盛起。
炒軟番茄，加入雞蛋拌勻，按口味調味。
配新鮮煮好的白飯。雞蛋須煮熟，並遵循當地食物安全指引。

en: Wash the spinach thoroughly and drain. Beat the eggs.
Heat oil and cook the spinach until wilted.
Add eggs and gently stir until fully set. Season to taste and serve.
zh-Hant: 徹底洗淨菠菜並瀝乾，打勻雞蛋。
熱油後加入菠菜，炒至軟身。
倒入蛋液輕炒至完全凝固，調味後享用。

en: Cook pasta according to its packaging, then drain; keep a little cooking water.
Cook the tomatoes in oil until soft. Add a little pasta water to loosen the sauce.
Toss with the pasta, season to taste and serve.
zh-Hant: 按包裝指示煮意粉，瀝乾並保留少量煮麵水。
用油炒軟番茄，加入少量煮麵水調整醬汁。
加入意粉拌勻，調味後享用。

en: Drain and cube the tofu. Wash the spinach thoroughly.
Heat oil and cook tofu until hot throughout, following the packaging instructions.
Add spinach and cook until wilted. Season with soy sauce to taste.
zh-Hant: 豆腐瀝乾切塊，徹底洗淨菠菜。
熱油後按包裝指示將豆腐煮至中心熱透。
加入菠菜炒至軟身，用豉油調味。
放在新鮮煮好的白飯上享用。
